recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a patterned jacket set against a deep blue, slightly textured background, featuring large, vertically stacked, condensed typography on the left side.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Typography is flush-left and vertically aligned with the subject's profile
High contrast between the yellow/white text and the dark blue background
Texture of the houndstooth jacket contrasts with the smooth skin tones and solid background
coreInvariants: Deep royal blue background with subtle gradient
Subject looking slightly off-camera with a neutral expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right, cropped at the waist, facing three-quarters toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the jacket, then jumps to the top-left text and follows it down to the yellow highlight.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left quadrant to accommodate the title.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue; high value contrast in the typography against the dark backdrop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, white, yellow, and natural skin/fabric tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is a narrow vertical oval
The 'S' has very short horizontal curves

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space beside subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color-based hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1960s-style swept-back hair wearing a grey houndstooth patterned blazer over a white collared shirt. The background should be a solid, deep royal blue with a subtle vignette. The man should be positioned on the right side of the frame, looking toward the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add five lines of ultra-condensed, bold sans-serif text in all-caps on the left side. Align the text flush-left. The first three lines should be white; the final two lines should be bright lemon yellow. Ensure the text is large and fills the vertical space from the top of the man's head to his waist.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep, saturated blue?
Is the jacket pattern a clear houndstooth or micro-check?
Are the bottom two lines of text yellow?

mustRedesign: Remove any specific logos or brand names in the corners
Ensure the face is a generic 1960s-style model, not a specific celebrity

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space on the left

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct color separation in text
Verify the jacket texture is sharp and detailed
Ensure the man's pose creates a clear vertical line for the text
Confirm the blue background is not overly noisy
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on right + Deep blue background + Stacked condensed sans-serif on left + Two-tone color hierarchy
